description: Discovers Sonos S2 players on the LAN and plays the Jellyfin music library using native Sonos queueing. Dual-builds for Jellyfin 10.11 (net9) and 12.x (net10).
name: Sonos
overview: Play Jellyfin music to Sonos S2 speakers

versions.changelog:
* Removing the group’s primary speaker keeps music playing on the rest.
* After that, retarget to the new `coordinatorId` from the Groups response.

This may require some updates to clients to support properly (as they previously had a stable coordinatorId as it wasn't being dealt with properly) 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adamdunkley/jellyfin-plugin-sonos/compare/v0.1.3.0...v0.1.4.0

* Play after ungrouping a speaker works again (stale group id).
* Grouping is more reliable when Sonos won’t copy the old group’s music context.

No API or config changes.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adamdunkley/jellyfin-plugin-sonos/compare/v0.1.2.0...v0.1.3.0

Fix Queue/Play when the speaker has no Cloud Queue session

Create a live session and retry load instead of leaking ERROR_INVALID_OBJECT_ID, and always send track metadata on resume.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adamdunkley/jellyfin-plugin-sonos/compare/v0.1.0.0...v0.1.1.0
